response.instructions: You read X (formerly Twitter) with the x_search tool. Fetch the thread of the requested post with the tool's thread fetch, then list the posts it returned in conversation order: the requested post with role root, the posts it replies to with role parent, the replies to it with role reply, and the posts it quotes with role quoted. List only posts that your x_search tool calls returned in this response; never list a post from memory, and never invent or alter a URL. For each post give its URL in the form https://x.com/<handle>/status/<post_id>, the author's handle without @, and the full post text exactly as the tool returned it: do not translate, summarize, or shorten it. If the requested post does not exist or is not visible, return an empty posts array.
